fitAgainstFrontLoadWasher.rationale: Nine wash-path procedures (inlet, drain, level, motor wash codes, wash heater/thermistor, overflow, unbalance, leak) map to front_load_washer functional systems: water_inlet, drain, water_level, drive, door_interlock, heating. Samsung-specific MEMS and drawer lock are implementation_specific overlays — no FL washer canonical mutation required for wash domain representation.
gaps: Shared motor also serves dry tumble — FL washer contract alone does not model post-wash dry authorization on same drive
Integrated Smart Install spans wash and dry — exceeds standalone FL washer service-mode scope

fitAgainstVentedDryer.rationale: WD53 dry architecture is heat-pump ventless condenser — not a variant of vented_dryer. vented_dryer rev2 functional model requires heated_airflow_path: heat_source → drum → lint_filter → blower → exhaust_path, with distinct lint_filter vs exhaust_path restriction domains and heat_source protected by thermal_fuse/cutoff on the heating element/burner path. WD53 uses BLDC compressor (3CA), refrigerant thermistors (EVA IN/OUT, discharge, compressor top), dehumidifying-kit magnet interlock (NC), condensation-based moisture rejection, supplemental dry heater auxiliary to heat pump, and auto-open door (DC5). None of these are optional implementation details of exhaust-based vented drying — they are a different moisture-rejection and heat-generation contract.

heatPumpEvaluation.question: Is heat-pump drying a variant of vented_dryer because both dry clothes?
heatPumpEvaluation.reason: vented_dryer canonical graph models exhaust-rejected moisture and fuel-agnostic heat_source on air stream — not sealed refrigerant loop with evaporator/condenser thermistor network

condenserVentlessEvaluation.question: Could condenser drying fit vented_dryer by omitting exhaust_path?
condenserVentlessEvaluation.reason: Omitting exhaust_path would break vented_dryer functional dependencies (airflow_operation, heated_airflow_path, exhaust_path_failure domain) — that is canonical mutation, not variant fit

rejectedSuperficialMappings.rejection: Supplemental to heat pump — not primary heated-air-stream heat_source
Tumble present but airflow path is sealed dehumidification, not lint→exhaust
Refrigerant circuit sensing — different sensed medium and control purpose

fitAgainstTopLoadWasher.rationale: WD53 is horizontal front-load single-drum architecture. No impeller, agitator, or TL suspension domains implicated. top_load_washer not a candidate host.

composedImplementationHypothesis.reason: Wash portion partial-fits front_load_washer; dry portion fails vented_dryer fit. Composed hypothesis requires both domains to satisfy existing contracts without mutation.

crossModeFunctionalRelationships: ULC foam from wash contaminating dehumidification path
Smart Install unified diagnostic spanning wash steps 1–8 and dry steps 9–10
Door lock authorization across wash and dry with dry-specific auto-open exit
integrationAnalysis.conclusion: Integration layer adds functional relationships neither front_load_washer nor vented_dryer represents — even if dry had fit vented, orchestration would still require explicit composed-contract documentation

explicitNonActions: No proven_variant closure — dry divergence blocks whole-appliance variant classification
